sourceNotice.en: Lecture 3, 22 September 2026. Based on the 51-page student slide deck and classroom transcript. Incomplete slide sections are supplemented from the transcript and labelled. Case percentages are unverified teaching examples.
sourceNotice.zh: Lecture 3（2026年9月22日）。根据51页学生版课件与课堂转录整理，留空或不清晰处按课堂讲述补充并标注。案例百分比仅作课件示例记录，未核实为研究结论。

objective.en: Understand shared aims and proactive improvement.
objective.zh: 理解共同目标与主动预防。

sections.title: Shared goals and limitations
sections.titleZh: 共同目标与实施限制
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
Advanced methods aim to enhance care quality, optimize operations, use evidence and support safety.
进阶方法旨在提升照护质量、优化运作、运用证据、支持安全目标。
Core methods: Taguchi, FTA, FMEA, Kaizen, Quality Circles, Six Sigma, Lean and Lean Sigma.
核心方法：田口方法、故障树分析、失效模式与影响分析、持续改善、品管圈、六西格玛、精益、精益六西格玛。
Proactive improvement identifies potential failures before patients are harmed.
主动预防是在患者受到伤害之前识别潜在失效。
Benefits depend on resources, data, training, staff participation and the fit with local conditions.
成效取决于资源、数据、培训、员工参与以及是否适合本地情境。
老师课堂补充 / Classroom commentary

老师反复强调：方法不同，但患者安全、有效性、效率和减少浪费仍是共同方向。Different tools share common improvement goals.

Lecture 3-Quality Management Methods II-student(1).pdf · PDF pages 4, 5, 6；Lesson3.docx 课堂转录（整理意译）

objective.en: Explain variation, robust design, noise factors and practical limits.
objective.zh: 理解变异、稳健设计、噪声因素及实际限制。

sections.title: Robust design
sections.titleZh: 稳健设计的核心
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
Taguchi methods emphasize reducing unwanted variation during design so a product or process performs consistently under varying conditions.
田口方法强调在设计阶段减少不必要变异，使产品或流程在不同条件下仍保持稳定表现。
Robust does not mean that conditions never change; it means performance is less sensitive to those changes.
稳健不是条件永远不变，而是表现较少受条件变化影响。
The slides credit Japanese engineer and statistician Genichi Taguchi.
课件介绍该方法由日本工程师、统计学家 Genichi Taguchi 发展。
辨析与学习提示 / Study note

重要辨析：不要把课堂中的“尽量减少变异”背成“完全没有变异”或“永远不用调整”。

Lecture 3-Quality Management Methods II-student(1).pdf · PDF pages 8, 9, 10

sections.title: Medical imaging example
sections.titleZh: 医学影像设备的稳健设计
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
The student slide introduces a medical imaging device but leaves the example incomplete.
学生版课件引出医学影像设备，但例子文字未写完整。
Classroom explanation: consider exposure settings and contrast alongside patient movement and machine calibration.
课堂补充：同时考虑曝光设置、对比度、患者移动和机器校准。
The design goal is reliable image quality despite variation in operating conditions.
设计目标是在操作条件变化时仍保持可靠图像质量。
老师课堂补充 / Classroom commentary

第10页留空部分依据老师讲述补充。老师提出把移动、校准和设置变化在设计阶段一起考虑。This completes the unfinished example using the transcript.

辨析与学习提示 / Study note

可联系你的 DICOM 项目理解“图像质量是否稳定”；这是教学案例，不是设备参数或临床设置建议。

Lecture 3-Quality Management Methods II-student(1).pdf · PDF pages 10；Lesson3.docx 课堂转录（整理意译）

sections.title: Orthogonal arrays and noise
sections.titleZh: 正交表、参数与噪声因素
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
Orthogonal arrays organize selected combinations of factors to study them efficiently. Signal-to-noise ratios help compare performance robustness.
正交表组织选定的因素组合，以较有效率地研究因素；信噪比帮助比较表现的稳健性。
The slides discuss dose, interval and biomarkers as factors, and patient differences or adherence as sources of variation.
课件讨论剂量、间隔、生物标志物等因素，以及患者差异或依从性等变异来源。
Noise means influences that are difficult to control in the design context, not necessarily audible sound.
Noise 在这里指设计情境中难以控制的影响，不一定是声音。
The chemotherapy example reports 35% fewer dose-related adverse events, but gives no identifiable study citation.
化疗例子写到剂量相关不良事件减少35%，但没有提供可识别的研究出处。
辨析与学习提示 / Study note

35%只作为课件示例数字记录。正交设计不能替代临床试验伦理、安全审查或个体化判断；不据此制定剂量。

Lecture 3-Quality Management Methods II-student(1).pdf · PDF pages 11, 13

sections.title: Strengths, limits and software
sections.titleZh: 优势、限制与分析工具
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
Strengths: reduced process variation, greater reliability and efficient use of experimental runs.
优势：减少流程变异、提高可靠性、较有效率地安排试验次数。
Limits: complex interactions, nonlinear healthcare processes, statistical expertise, training and cultural resistance.
限制：复杂交互作用、医疗流程的非线性、统计能力、培训和文化阻力。
The software slide lists Minitab, JMP, Design-Expert and R as examples.
工具页列出 Minitab、JMP、Design-Expert、R 作为例子。
Clinical knowledge and statistical knowledge must be combined to interpret results meaningfully.
解释结果需要结合临床知识与统计知识。
老师课堂补充 / Classroom commentary

老师说软件名称用于举例，不要求全部背诵；也提醒只会计算、不了解临床背景并不够。Software was illustrative; clinical understanding is needed alongside analysis.

辨析与学习提示 / Study note

第14页部分文字显示不清，结合可提取文字与课堂讲述整理。不将课件关于“线性”的简述推广为所有田口设计都只能处理线性关系。

Lecture 3-Quality Management Methods II-student(1).pdf · PDF pages 12, 14；Lesson3.docx 课堂转录（整理意译）

objective.en: Distinguish failure causes from failure modes and effects.
objective.zh: 区分失效原因与失效模式及影响。

sections.title: Fault Tree Analysis
sections.titleZh: 故障树分析的方向与逻辑门
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
FTA = Fault Tree Analysis. Start from an undesired top event and trace combinations of contributing causes downward.
FTA＝故障树分析。从不希望发生的顶事件开始，向下追查促成原因及其组合。
FTA is top-down and deductive; basic events are linked through AND and OR logic gates.
FTA 是自上而下的演绎分析，以 AND、OR 逻辑门连接基本事件。
AND requires the linked conditions together; OR can be satisfied by any linked condition.
AND 要求相关条件同时成立；OR 表示任一相关条件成立即可。
The slide’s diagram uses an incorrect insulin dose as the top event and traces possible delivery or calculation failures.
课件图以错误胰岛素剂量为顶事件，追查可能的输送或计算失效。
辨析与学习提示 / Study note

FTA 从失效事件往下找原因，不是单纯按时间顺序画流程图。它可帮助根因调查，但不等于所有 Root Cause Analysis 方法。

Lecture 3-Quality Management Methods II-student(1).pdf · PDF pages 16, 17, 18, 19

sections.title: FTA healthcare cases
sections.titleZh: 用药错误与麻醉设备案例
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
For medication errors, build a fault tree to identify critical pathways and select preventive measures.
针对用药错误，建立故障树识别关键路径，再选择预防措施。
The anesthesia example traces gas leaks, incorrect settings, valve faults and missed pre-use checks associated with hypoxia.
麻醉例子追查与缺氧相关的气体泄漏、设置错误、阀门故障及漏做使用前检查。
Responses include preventive maintenance, pre-use checks and staff training.
应对包括预防性维护、使用前检查和员工培训。
辨析与学习提示 / Study note

这是风险分析学习，不是麻醉设备故障排查操作指引。

Lecture 3-Quality Management Methods II-student(1).pdf · PDF pages 17, 20

sections.title: Failure modes and effects
sections.titleZh: FMEA 步骤与风险排序
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
FMEA = Failure Mode and Effects Analysis. Identify how a process may fail, its effects and actions to reduce the risk.
FMEA＝失效模式与影响分析。识别流程可能怎样失效、有什么影响，以及如何降低风险。
Map the process, identify failure modes, assess effects and prioritize risks before selecting corrective actions.
绘制流程、识别失效模式、评估影响、排列风险优先级，再选择改进措施。
The medication case uses severity, occurrence and detection scores.
用药案例使用严重度、发生频度和可检测性评分。
Severity concerns consequences; occurrence concerns how often failure may happen; detection concerns finding it before harm.
严重度关注后果；发生频度关注发生可能性；可检测性关注能否在造成伤害前发现。
老师课堂补充 / Classroom commentary

老师特别补充：流程图应覆盖所有步骤，不应只画已经知道的高风险步骤。Map all steps, not just previously identified high-risk steps.

辨析与学习提示 / Study note

不同评分表对 detection 的方向定义可能不同，本讲材料未给评分表，不能自行补出统一阈值。

Lecture 3-Quality Management Methods II-student(1).pdf · PDF pages 21, 22；Lesson3.docx 课堂转录（整理意译）

sections.title: Medication and transfusion FMEA
sections.titleZh: 用药与输血安全案例
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
The medication case examines prescribing, dispensing and administration, including wrong dose and wrong patient.
用药案例覆盖处方、配药和给药，识别错误剂量、错误患者等模式。
The slides describe barcode scanning and double-check procedures for medication and transfusion safety.
课件描述条码扫描与双重核对，用于用药和输血安全。
The medication case reports a 58% error-rate reduction over six months; no study citation is supplied.
用药案例报告六个月内错误率降低58%；材料没有附研究出处。
辨析与学习提示 / Study note

58%是课件示例数据，不是已核实研究结论或普遍效果。技术仍需配合正确流程与员工遵循。

Lecture 3-Quality Management Methods II-student(1).pdf · PDF pages 22, 23

sections.title: FTA versus FMEA
sections.titleZh: FTA 与 FMEA 怎么区分
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
FTA asks: what combinations of causes could lead to this failure event?
FTA 问：哪些原因组合可能导致这个失效事件？
FMEA asks: how could each process step fail, what would happen, and how should we reduce the risk?
FMEA 问：各流程步骤可能怎样失效、后果是什么、如何降低风险？
They can complement each other in proactive risk assessment.
两者可在主动风险评估中互相补充。
辨析与学习提示 / Study note

辅助比较题；关键词检查不能判断名称是否写反，请结合参考答案自查。

Lecture 3-Quality Management Methods II-student(1).pdf · PDF pages 18, 21

title.zh: 持续改善文化与品管圈

objective.en: Explain small improvements, frontline participation and sustainability.
objective.zh: 理解小步改善、一线参与和长期维持。

sections.title: Kaizen philosophy
sections.titleZh: Kaizen：小步、持续、全员
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
Kaizen means change for the better: small, incremental and continuous improvements involving employees.
Kaizen 指持续向好改变：通过员工参与，进行小规模、渐进、持续的改善。
Core practices: daily improvements, staff empowerment, reducing waste, standardization, data-driven iteration and patient-centered care.
核心做法：每日改善、员工赋权、减少浪费、标准化、数据驱动迭代、以患者为中心。
Effective small changes become standards and provide a base for the next improvement.
有效的小改变形成标准，并成为下一轮改善的基础。
辨析与学习提示 / Study note

联系 Lesson 2：BPR 更强调根本性重设计；Kaizen 更强调日常小步改善。

Lecture 3-Quality Management Methods II-student(1).pdf · PDF pages 25, 26, 28

sections.title: Kaizen cases
sections.titleZh: 急症室与出院流程改善
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
A&E example: map the patient journey, identify bottlenecks, test small fixes, measure results and repeat.
急症室例子：描绘患者流程、找瓶颈、尝试小改变、测量结果、再迭代。
The slides mention lab-order preparation and better communication between triage and laboratory staff.
课件举例包括检验申请准备、分流与检验人员之间的沟通改善。
Discharge example: identify daily bottlenecks and streamline paperwork to improve patient flow.
出院例子：每日识别瓶颈、简化文书，改善患者流转。
老师课堂补充 / Classroom commentary

老师强调一线人员最熟悉步骤和问题，应先听取他们的意见，而不是管理者单独设计所有改变。Frontline knowledge should inform changes.

Lecture 3-Quality Management Methods II-student(1).pdf · PDF pages 27, 29；Lesson3.docx 课堂转录（整理意译）

sections.title: Quality Circles
sections.titleZh: 品管圈：小组定期解决问题
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
Quality Circles are small groups of employees who meet regularly to identify, analyze and solve work-related problems.
品管圈是员工组成的小组，定期识别、分析并解决工作相关问题。
The slide describes typically 5–10 members from one unit, with a facilitator and management support.
课件描述通常由同一单位5–10名成员组成，有引导者和管理支持。
Tools include brainstorming, root cause analysis and PDCA. Participation builds shared responsibility and ownership.
工具包括头脑风暴、根因分析和 PDCA；参与有助于形成共同责任和主人翁意识。
老师课堂补充 / Classroom commentary

老师强调管理层支持的重要性：否则建议可能得不到资源落实。Management support helps turn ideas into action.

Lecture 3-Quality Management Methods II-student(1).pdf · PDF pages 30, 31；Lesson3.docx 课堂转录（整理意译）

sections.title: Sustain improvement cultures
sections.titleZh: 持续开展的五个条件
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
Leadership commitment; staff engagement; training culture; open communication; system integration.
领导承诺、员工参与、培训文化、开放沟通、系统整合。
Leaders allocate resources; staff contribute ideas; training builds capability; safe feedback channels allow problems to surface.
领导配置资源；员工提供意见；培训建立能力；安全反馈渠道让问题能被提出。
Align improvement with hospital goals and embed successful changes into policy and routine practice.
让改善与医院目标一致，并把有效改变写入政策和日常实践。
Lecture 3-Quality Management Methods II-student(1).pdf · PDF pages 32

objective.en: Know DMAIC and distinguish variation reduction from waste reduction.
objective.zh: 掌握 DMAIC，区分减少变异与减少浪费。

sections.title: Six Sigma and DMAIC
sections.titleZh: Six Sigma 与 DMAIC 五步
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
Six Sigma uses data to reduce defects and process variability.
Six Sigma 用数据减少缺陷和流程变异。
DMAIC = Define, Measure, Analyze, Improve, Control.
DMAIC＝定义、测量、分析、改进、控制。
Define the problem; measure current performance; analyze causes; improve the process; control it to sustain gains.
定义问题；测量当前表现；分析原因；改进流程；通过控制维持成效。
Radiology example: analyze patient flow, locate bottlenecks and change scheduling to reduce waits.
放射科例子：分析患者流转、找瓶颈、调整预约安排来减少等待。
老师课堂补充 / Classroom commentary

老师说明 DMAIC 可用于真实流程问题分析，并提到以往学生曾用于作业或案例研究。DMAIC was discussed as an applied problem-solving structure.

辨析与学习提示 / Study note

转录中的正态分布百分比识别不清，本笔记不据此给出“六西格玛等于某准确率”的结论。关键词匹配不检查步骤顺序。

Lecture 3-Quality Management Methods II-student(1).pdf · PDF pages 34, 35；Lesson3.docx 课堂转录（整理意译）

sections.title: Lean management
sections.titleZh: Lean：减少不增值步骤
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
Lean eliminates waste and maximizes value by improving flow and removing non-value-added activities.
Lean 通过改善流转、减少不增值活动来消除浪费并提升价值。
In the A&E example, the team maps value streams, streamlines triage and improves bed turnover.
急症室例子使用价值流分析、简化分流流程并改善床位周转。
Visual management and daily huddles help sustain the changes.
可视化管理和每日短会有助于维持改进。
The example reports a 40% fall in triage assessment time; it supplies no study citation.
例子报告分流评估时间下降40%；材料没有附研究出处。
辨析与学习提示 / Study note

减少浪费不等于删除必要的安全检查。40%仅作为课件示例结果，不作为通用效果。

Lecture 3-Quality Management Methods II-student(1).pdf · PDF pages 36, 37

sections.title: Six Sigma versus Lean
sections.titleZh: 变异与流程浪费的区别
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
Six Sigma focuses on defects and variability using data analysis and statistical control.
Six Sigma 重点是缺陷与变异，运用数据分析和统计控制。
Lean focuses on flow, waiting, resource efficiency and removing non-value-added work.
Lean 重点是流转、等待、资源效率和不增值工作。
They overlap and can be combined; a delay problem may require both flow analysis and variation analysis.
两者有交集，可以组合使用；延误问题可能同时需要流程分析与变异分析。
辨析与学习提示 / Study note

这是一道辨析题；请自查两种方法是否写反，关键词核对不能替代理解。

Lecture 3-Quality Management Methods II-student(1).pdf · PDF pages 37

objective.en: Combine flow and variation improvement, and evaluate outcomes carefully.
objective.zh: 结合流转与变异改善，谨慎解释效果数据。

sections.title: Lean Sigma and surgical infections
sections.titleZh: Lean Sigma 与手术部位感染案例
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
Lean Sigma combines Lean’s flow and waste focus with Six Sigma’s defect and variation focus.
Lean Sigma 结合 Lean 对流转和浪费的关注，以及 Six Sigma 对缺陷和变异的关注。
The surgical-site infection case streamlines surgical processes and examines sources of variation associated with infection rates.
手术部位感染案例一方面梳理手术流程，另一方面分析与感染率相关的变异来源。
The teaching case reports improved outcomes but does not provide a source study or detailed protocol.
教学案例描述结果改善，但未提供研究来源或具体临床操作方案。
Lecture 3-Quality Management Methods II-student(1).pdf · PDF pages 39, 40

sections.title: Conditions for Lean Sigma
sections.titleZh: 实施所需的四方面支持
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
Leadership, training, culture and organizational alignment support Lean Sigma implementation.
领导、培训、文化及组织目标一致性支持 Lean Sigma 实施。
Leaders set goals and resources; staff learn DMAIC and value stream mapping; teams share accountability and collaborate.
领导设定目标与资源；员工学习 DMAIC 和价值流分析；团队共同承担责任并协作。
Shared vision helps integrate improvement into everyday work.
共同愿景有助于把改善融入日常工作。
老师课堂补充 / Classroom commentary

老师解释 accountability 不应理解为把所有责任推给一线，而应联系共同目标和责任。Accountability was linked to shared responsibility rather than blame shifting.

Lecture 3-Quality Management Methods II-student(1).pdf · PDF pages 41；Lesson3.docx 课堂转录（整理意译）

sections.title: Read performance metrics critically
sections.titleZh: 如何看课件中的改善数据
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
The slide reports operational costs down 15–20%, transition defects down 40%, satisfaction scores up 30%, and average stay down 1.8 days within a year.
课件列出：运营成本下降15–20%、照护转衔缺陷下降40%、满意度评分上升30%、一年内平均住院日减少1.8天。
These numbers lack named study sources, baseline definitions and sample details in the supplied material.
所给材料未说明这些数字对应的具名研究、基线定义和样本细节。
Study reflection: ask what was measured, the comparison period, patient differences and whether other changes could explain the result.
学习反思：询问测量对象、比较时段、患者差异，以及是否存在其他解释。
辨析与学习提示 / Study note

保留数字用于识别课件案例，但不当作已核实的研究证据，也不据此计算因果效果。

Lecture 3-Quality Management Methods II-student(1).pdf · PDF pages 42

title.zh: 方法选择、整合与采用障碍

objective.en: Select tools by problem and critically reflect on adoption barriers.
objective.zh: 按问题选择工具，并反思实施障碍。

sections.title: Select and combine methods
sections.titleZh: 如何选择及整合方法
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
Choose methods based on the problem, organizational size, culture, resources, data needs and team involvement.
按问题类型、机构规模、文化、资源、数据需求及团队参与选择方法。
Possible matches: FMEA for potential process failures; FTA for failure pathways; Lean for waste and delays; Six Sigma for variability; Kaizen for daily incremental change.
可用匹配：FMEA 识别潜在流程失效；FTA 分析故障路径；Lean 改善浪费与延误；Six Sigma 减少变异；Kaizen 支持日常小步改善。
Integrate frameworks, standardize protocols, form cross-functional teams and use shared data platforms or dashboards.
整合框架、统一规程、组成跨部门团队，并使用共享数据平台或仪表板。
辨析与学习提示 / Study note

方法不是互斥选项；不要机械地把一个问题永久对应到一种工具。

Lecture 3-Quality Management Methods II-student(1).pdf · PDF pages 44, 45

sections.title: Digitalization, AI and benchmarking
sections.titleZh: 数字化、AI 与国际对标
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
Digital tools such as EHRs and IoT can support data access and quality monitoring.
电子健康记录（EHR）和物联网（IoT）等数字工具可支持数据获取和质量监测。
AI-assisted analysis can identify patterns and potential failures; global benchmarking helps identify performance gaps.
AI 辅助分析可识别模式和潜在失效；国际对标有助于发现绩效差距。
These are directions for quality improvement, not a guarantee that technology alone improves care.
这些是质量改善方向，不代表技术本身就能保证改善照护。
老师课堂补充 / Classroom commentary

老师补充患者隐私、数据泄露和系统安全维护问题。The lecturer highlighted privacy, leakage and security.

辨析与学习提示 / Study note

学习延伸：防火墙只是安全控制的一部分；AI 还需可靠数据、验证和人工监督。这些不是课件所报告的效果保证。

Lecture 3-Quality Management Methods II-student(1).pdf · PDF pages 46；Lesson3.docx 课堂转录（整理意译）

sections.title: Resistance to change
sections.titleZh: 采用障碍一：变革阻力
sections.html:
老师课堂明确强调 / Lecturer emphasis
Resistance may reflect fear of the unknown, loss of control, job-security concerns, communication gaps or lack of involvement.
阻力可能来自对未知的担心、失去控制感、工作保障顾虑、沟通不足或缺少参与。
Critical reflection asks why resistance occurs and whether managers have explained the purpose, benefits and expectations.
批判性反思是追问阻力为什么出现，以及管理者是否解释了目的、好处和预期。
Involve affected staff in planning and decisions to support understanding and ownership.
让受影响员工参与规划和决策，有助于理解及形成主人翁意识。
老师课堂补充 / Classroom commentary

老师以员工担心 AI 影响工作保障为例，强调说明目的、听取意见和员工参与。The AI example illustrated job-security concerns.

辨析与学习提示 / Study note

“Encourage critical reflection on barriers to adoption”＝鼓励深入分析新方法为何难以落实，并提出有依据的应对；不只是列出障碍名称。

Lecture 3-Quality Management Methods II-student(1).pdf · PDF pages 47, 48, 49；Lesson3.docx 课堂转录（整理意译）

sections.title: Resource constraints
sections.titleZh: 采用障碍二：资源限制
sections.html:
老师课堂明确强调 / Lecturer emphasis
Consider funds, personnel, time, infrastructure, technology and technical support before implementation.
实施前考虑资金、人手、时间、基础设施、技术与支持能力。
Opportunity cost is what must be given up or delayed when resources are committed to a new initiative.
机会成本是把资源投入新计划时，需要放弃或推迟的其他选择。
Assess capacity realistically, make trade-offs transparent and prioritize projects with staff input.
现实评估能力、清晰说明取舍，并结合员工意见排列项目优先级。
老师课堂补充 / Classroom commentary

老师结尾反复提醒管理者同时考虑 resistance to change 与 resource constraints。Both barriers were repeatedly emphasized at the end.

Lecture 3-Quality Management Methods II-student(1).pdf · PDF pages 50；Lesson3.docx 课堂转录（整理意译）

question.en: Name two shared aims: one about care quality and one about safety.
question.zh: 列出两个共同目标：一个关于照护质量，一个关于安全。

answer.en: Enhance care quality and support patient safety.
answer.zh: 提升照护质量并支持患者安全。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 3 PDF pages 4, 5, 6

question.en: What does robust design try to maintain when conditions vary?
question.zh: 条件变化时，稳健设计希望保持什么？

answer.zh: 稳定表现，并减少变异。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 3 PDF pages 8, 9, 10

question.en: Which two sources of variation were discussed in the imaging example?
question.zh: 影像例子讨论了哪两个变异来源？

answer.en: Patient movement and machine calibration issues.
answer.zh: 患者移动和机器校准问题。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 3 PDF pages 10

question.en: Name the two Taguchi tools mentioned for arranging trials and comparing robustness.
question.zh: 写出组织试验与比较稳健性的两种田口工具。

answer.zh: 正交表和信噪比。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 3 PDF pages 11, 13

question.en: Name two implementation barriers concerning skills and change.
question.zh: 列出两个与能力和改变有关的实施障碍。

answer.en: Limited statistical expertise and resistance to change.
answer.zh: 统计能力不足和变革阻力。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 3 PDF pages 12, 14

question.en: What is the direction of FTA, and which two logic gates are used?
question.zh: FTA 分析方向是什么？使用哪两个逻辑门？

answer.zh: 自上而下；AND 和 OR 逻辑门。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 3 PDF pages 16, 17, 18, 19

question.en: Name two prevention measures in the anesthesia example.
question.zh: 列出麻醉设备例子中的两项预防措施。

answer.zh: 预防性维护和员工培训。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 3 PDF pages 17, 20

question.en: Which three risk-rating dimensions appear in the medication FMEA case?
question.zh: 用药 FMEA 案例用了哪三个风险评分维度？

answer.zh: 严重度、发生频度、可检测性。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 3 PDF pages 21, 22

question.en: Which two safety measures appear in the transfusion case?
question.zh: 输血案例提出哪两种安全措施？

answer.zh: 双重核对和条码扫描。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 3 PDF pages 22, 23

question.en: Which method uses a fault tree, and which examines failure modes and effects?
question.zh: 哪种方法用故障树？哪种分析失效模式与影响？

answer.en: FTA uses a fault tree; FMEA examines failure modes and effects.
answer.zh: FTA 用故障树；FMEA 分析失效模式与影响。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 3 PDF pages 18, 21

question.en: What three words describe the scale, pace and duration of Kaizen improvements?
question.zh: 用三个词描述 Kaizen 改善的规模、方式和持续性。

answer.zh: 小规模、渐进、持续。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 3 PDF pages 25, 26, 28

question.en: What should a Kaizen team identify before testing small changes in patient flow?
question.zh: 在测试患者流转的小改变前，Kaizen 团队应找出什么？

answer.zh: 患者流程中的瓶颈。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 3 PDF pages 27, 29

question.en: What does a Quality Circle do regularly, and what group size is described?
question.zh: 品管圈定期做什么？课件描述多少名成员？

answer.en: Meet to identify, analyze and solve work problems; typically 5–10 members.
answer.zh: 定期开会识别、分析、解决工作问题；通常5–10名成员。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 3 PDF pages 30, 31

question.en: List the five conditions for sustaining Kaizen and Quality Circles.
question.zh: 列出维持 Kaizen 与品管圈的五个条件。

answer.en: Leadership commitment; staff engagement; training culture; open communication; system integration.
answer.zh: 领导承诺；员工参与；培训文化；开放沟通；系统整合。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 3 PDF pages 32

question.en: Expand DMAIC in order.
question.zh: 按顺序写出 DMAIC。

answer.zh: 定义、测量、分析、改进、控制。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 3 PDF pages 34, 35

question.en: What does Lean seek to eliminate, and what does it maximize?
question.zh: Lean 希望消除什么、最大化什么？

answer.zh: 消除浪费、最大化价值。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 3 PDF pages 36, 37

question.en: Which method emphasizes variability, and which emphasizes waste and flow?
question.zh: 哪种方法重点处理变异？哪种重点处理浪费与流转？

answer.en: Six Sigma addresses variability; Lean addresses waste and flow.
answer.zh: Six Sigma 处理变异；Lean 处理浪费与流转。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 3 PDF pages 37

question.en: Which two methods are combined in Lean Sigma?
question.zh: Lean Sigma 结合哪两种方法？

answer.zh: Lean 和 Six Sigma。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 3 PDF pages 39, 40

question.en: Name the four implementation supports described on the slide.
question.zh: 列出课件描述的四方面实施支持。

answer.zh: 领导；培训；文化；目标一致性。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 3 PDF pages 41

question.en: Can the slide percentages be treated as guaranteed results for every hospital?
question.zh: 能把这些百分比当作每家医院必然达到的效果吗？

answer.en: No. The source and context must be checked.
answer.zh: 不能，需要核对来源与情境。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 3 PDF pages 42

question.en: Which three context factors on the slide influence method choice?
question.zh: 课件列出的哪三个情境因素影响方法选择？

answer.zh: 机构规模、文化、资源。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 3 PDF pages 44, 45

question.en: Name the three future directions highlighted in this section.
question.zh: 列出本节强调的三项未来方向。

answer.en: Digitalization, AI-assisted quality control and global benchmarking.
answer.zh: 数字化、AI辅助质量控制、国际对标。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 3 PDF pages 46

question.en: Name two management responses to resistance: one about communication and one about participation.
question.zh: 针对变革阻力，给出沟通与参与方面各一个应对。

answer.en: Explain the purpose clearly and involve staff in planning.
answer.zh: 清晰沟通目的，并让员工参与规划。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 3 PDF pages 47, 48, 49

question.en: What three basic resource shortages are listed under financial and human capital?
question.zh: 资金与人力资本一项列出哪三种基本资源不足？

answer.zh: 资金、人手、时间不足。
